properties_verified.test_name: 9. Durable Persistence — records are committed to SQLite tables
properties_verified.details: Model observation and K5 receipt records survive beyond application runtime memory and are stored directly in SQLite tables k5_verification_receipts and model_observations.

properties_verified.test_name: 10. Deterministic Reconstruction — survives process restart and restores exact state
properties_verified.details: New instance of ModelCapabilityHistory connected to existing database reconstructs exact observation count, success rates, latency averages, and active receipt bindings.

properties_verified.test_name: 11. Restart-Safe Idempotency — re-recording existing observations causes zero duplicate inflation
properties_verified.details: Re-recording observations on cold start or after restart causes zero duplicate row insertions in SQLite and zero inflation in queryVerifiedSuccessRate.
